author: Andy Clubb
text: We had a great experience with A1 Texas Gold. They came out to pump our septic system and helped us get everything back online after some persistent ants caused damage to our equipment. From the initial call to the completion of the job, their communication was excellent. They kept us informed every step of the way, showed up when they said they would, and worked diligently to make sure our system was functioning properly again.

author: South Texas Metal Roofing
text: Beyond being a great business, Jordan & his company A1 Texas Gold have become great friends over the years. It's rare to find a company that combines outstanding customer service with such honesty, integrity and kindness. I highly recommend them to anyone needing portable restroom rentals or septic services in the Rockport area. You won't find a better group of people to work with!

author: Susan Allen
text: We had to have our 2 septic tanks pumped out. They promptly came out and serviced both tanks between the periods of rain. They also added a more non-invasive cap so water cannot get in and it can be serviced without having to dig out next time. They did a great job!

author: Wende Dlabaja
text: I reached out to Jordan Pilgrim and he was so helpful when I had issues and questions about septic tanks!  He was very patient and helped me learn about my septic tank and talked me through some issues.  Highly recommend him and his expert team! I now refer all my clients to them. They will be taken care of for sure.
